'''April 2001 Cookeville tournament (28 April)''' was a Star Wars CCG booster draft held at Merchant Gamer, Cookeville, Tennessee on 28 April 2001. [[Mike Wudhapitak]] won it. It is known from Mike Wudhapitak's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2181">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-cookeville-tennessee-4-28-01d2181/ cookeville-tennessee-4-28-01], DeckTech (Mike "Anime Knight" Wudhapitak, 29 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-cookeville-tennessee-4-28-01d2181/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Merchant Gamer, Cookeville, Tennessee
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections II Booster Draft]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Mike Wudhapitak]]
